# WITD — Wake In The Dream

> Independent streetwear ecommerce storefront. Minimal, philosophical, premium clothing — not a generic AI-fashion brand.

## Docs

- [Home](https://wakeinthedream.com/): brand intro and current drop
- [Shop](https://wakeinthedream.com/shop): full product catalog, filterable by category
- [About](https://wakeinthedream.com/about): brand philosophy, shipping, returns, contact
- [Community](https://wakeinthedream.com/community): Discord community access for customers

## APIs

- [Product catalog (JSON)](https://wakeinthedream.com/api/products): all products, prices, colors, sizes, stock
- [Categories (JSON)](https://wakeinthedream.com/api/categories): category and subcategory tree

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://wakeinthedream.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Privacy Policy](https://wakeinthedream.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://wakeinthedream.com/terms)
